thread:
jordan: Opening follow-up from last night's OOM wave — observed KV shard blowups across two clusters at ~02:13 UTC. Root cause suspected: slow KV eviction + sudden fragment spike. Posting a compact action list and owners so we can close the postmortem loop.

liam: ack. can you paste the minimal repro profile or the heap-sample id?

jordan: yes — heap-sample: alloc-2026-04-09-0214.tar.gz (S3: s3://infra-dumps/alloc-2026-04-09-0214). Key items: large residency tail on shard-7, fragmentation heatmap shows 3x fragmentation ratio after the burst.

maya: i skimmed the sample — we see ~120MB of stranded KV meta per shard due to delayed GC of tombstones. also, frequent partial rehashes that hold slabs longer.

sophie: quick mitigation: raise per-shard soft-limit and enable immediate tombstone purge for hot partitions? i'd like a safe canary change we can push tonight.

liam: proposed canary steps (short):
1) config: "kv.soft_limit_per_shard" +20%
2) enable fast-tombstone-compact=true for shards with >90% residency
3) add eviction smokecheck to CI (alloc-sampler test)
I can own the canary. target: deploy to canary pool by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: liam owns canary. add test and a rollback flag. Sophie — can you own the immediate config PR and canary runbook?

sophie: yep, i'll open PR with changelog and rollback steps. ETA: PR in 3 hours, canary runbook doc linked from PR.

maya: long-term followups from postmortem:
- profiling: add low-overhead continuous allocation sampling (owner: maya) — instrumented for per-shard residency histograms.
- GC tuning: evaluate incremental GC threshold; run 2-week A/B (owner: jordan).
- fragmentation: add periodic defragmentation job for shards flagged by heatmap (>2.0 frag ratio) (owner: liam).
- observability: surface "tombstone life" metric and per-shard eviction misses (owner: sophie).

jordan: assigning timelines:
- canary deploy (liam + sophie): by 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC
- alloc-sampler in CI (liam): feature branch this week, merge by 2026-04-12
- continuous sampling (maya): prototype by 2026-04-17
- GC A/B experiment (jordan): plan + infra by 2026-04-20
- defrag job PoC (liam): by 2026-04-24
- observability metrics (sophie): dashboard + alert thresholds by 2026-04-15

devops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-0410-KV-OM; severity: S2; reminders scheduled for owners 48h before due dates.

liam: note — adding alloc-sampler to CI needs a small container bump (libjemalloc 5.3.0 -> 5.3.2). I'll include in PR.

maya: quick note on regression risk: fast-tombstone-compact can raise CPU by ~4-6% in spike windows — include CPU budget in canary SLA.

sophie: added CPU budget line to runbook and a canary healthcheck script that fails if 95th latency > 250ms or CPU > 80% for 5m.

jordan: good. last item: recurring incident pattern detection — i'll add a weekly query to spot >2 shard OOMs in 7d and auto-open this thread template. Owner: jordan, cadence weekly starting next Monday.

liam: I'll kick off a short dry-run of the canary on staging later today and post results.

maya: assigning follow-up checklist in the postmortem doc: https://redwood-internal/pm/kvcache-oom-2026-04-09 (see section 'Remediations & Owners').

sophie: thanks — ping me if you want a quick pairing for the runbook test. :thumbsup:

jordan: closing for now — we'll reconvene after canary results. add any blockers here. :calendar:
